features: Three original realms, three guardians and six rune sigils
Observed-input-completable story with mercy and rekindle endings
Sword, spells, double jump, dash and short-window frontal guard/projectile reflection
Keyboard remapping, multi-touch controls and standard-layout controller menus
Original HD realm plates, compact-scene-aware mini-map and local journal milestones
Validated portable journey saves, replacement/restore confirmation, rolling backup and stale-read cancellation
Session-only play when browser storage is denied

browser.transport: Local CDP Fetch serves exact exported bytes
browser.keyboardTouchMouseFileAndDownload: Actual Chromium input and DOM APIs
browser.audio: Web Audio running after real user gesture
browser.controller: Standards-shaped synthetic navigator gamepad exercises actual poller; not physical hardware
browser.endingRestore: Native file import of an input-earned completed campaign save
browser.sandbox: Explicit no-sandbox opt-in in isolated test container

visualReview.compactLandscape: Clear prompt and controls; mini-map hidden
